svg.title: nonlinear193 — the folded gadget: one r57 gate c ^= a | !b over nonlinear encodings
svg.desc: The replicated per-gate body: exactly 193 gates, deterministically (the '193' in the name). Every value 2-shared: v = E(v1) ⊕ E(v2), E(x0..x4) = x0⊕x1⊕maj(x2,x3,x4); ONE carrier (s2 majority) flipped by W = u⊕V, u = E(s1)⊕E(R) — the re-share is folded into the flip. Encoding setup and the 0-gate output relabeling are fixed infrastructure, not shown; borrows (R, ch) arrive on pool wires.

x0⊕x1⊕maj(x2,x3,x4); ONE carrier (s2 majority) flipped by W = u⊕V, u = E(s1)⊕E(R) — the re-share is folded into the flip. Encoding setup and the 0-gate

scr: restored to clean; scr2 built and unbuilt per group
c' = c ⊕ (a ∨ ¬b); share1' = R, share2' = (s2_0, s2_1, o0, o1, o2) — the relabel costs 0 gates
